note: For each conv channel: the 6 test drawings (10 base classes, 15,000 images) with the highest maximum pre-ReLU activation. 'patch' = base64 uint8 crop of the input around the receptive field 'rf' [y0,x0,y1,x1], padded by 'pad' pixels (zeros outside the image), patchSize x patchSize; the receptive field is the inner rfSize x rfSize square. (y, x) = the cell in the layer's own map. classMeanMax = mean over each class's test drawings of the channel's maximum activation (order = classes).
iconNote: icon = input patch (same crop as the top patches) optimised by gradient ascent to maximise the channel's centre-cell pre-ReLU activation: input = sigmoid(3x3 binomial blur of a free 28x28 map), random +-1 px jitter, Adam lr 0.05, 400 steps, penalties 3*total variation + 1*mean ink. iconAct = the activation it reaches.
